claim: Sep-2026 figures corroborated independently of the parse
detail: Reports standalone PAT Rs 14,843 cr (+20.1% YoY, from Rs 12,359 cr), NII Rs 25,339 cr (from Rs 21,529 cr), GNPA 1.20%, NNPA 0.30% for Q2 FY27; NIM 4.18%. The year-ago PAT base (Rs 12,359 cr) also matches the panel's Sep-2025 row exactly.
source: Business Today -- 'ICICI Bank Q2 results: Net profit jumps 20% to Rs 14,843 crore; NIM contracts'

claim: Disclosed provision coverage, and the buffers held outside that ratio
detail: The bank's disclosed provisioning coverage ratio on non-performing loans stood at 75% at 30 Sep 2026 (pipeline check below compares it with the panel's ratio-implied coverage). Provisions fell sharply to Rs 851 cr in the quarter, from Rs 1,260 cr in Q1 FY27 and Rs 914 cr a year earlier. Gross NPA additions were Rs 4,833 cr; recoveries and upgrades, excluding write-offs and sales, were Rs 3,620 cr. The filing also shows what sits OUTSIDE that ratio: contingency provisions of Rs 13,100 cr plus an additional standard-asset provision of Rs 1,283 cr (created Q3 FY26 as directed by the RBI for the agricultural priority-sector portfolio).
source: CNBC-TV18 -- 'ICICI Bank Q2 results: Beats estimates as lower provisions aid profit, but margins face pressure'

claim: Balance-sheet growth and capital position in Q2 FY27
detail: Total period-end deposits Rs 20.49 lakh cr (+27.1% YoY; +17% excluding FCNR(B) deposits) and total loan portfolio Rs 18.31 lakh cr (+30% YoY; +24.1% ex-FCNR(B)) at 30 Sep 2026. Total capital adequacy 16.68%; CET-1 16.01%. Consolidated net profit of Rs 16,333 cr (+22.3% YoY) is reported separately and is NOT the figure the standalone panel is checked against.
source: The Economic Times -- 'ICICI Bank Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 20% YoY to Rs 14,843 crore, NII rises 18%'
